package fixture

// Cache owns the values for one service instance.
type Cache struct{ values map[string]string }

// NewCache returns an initialized cache.
func NewCache() *Cache { return &Cache{values: make(map[string]string)} }

// Put stores a value. The caller serializes access to this instance.
func (c *Cache) Put(key, value string) { c.values[key] = value }

// Ready reports whether the cache has been initialized.
func (c *Cache) Ready() bool { return c.values != nil }
